title: Phone on sleep and lock screen causing connection issues - huawei
body:
Phone: Huawei P10 with Android 8.0. 
Xdrip build: 9 April 2018.

I recently observed the following:

1. While I am using my phone; or the phone is charging, there are minimal connection issues. 
2. While the phone's display is on sleep mode; or screen lock, the capture rate is approx. 20% 
3. When the screen is switched back on, xdrip status screen shows Scanning commenced at the same time.
4. I installed and tried a Keep Screen On app overnight, capture rate increased to >90%.

The logs have been emailed via xdrip from the overnight test.

I have 'Run collector in Foreground' checked in xdrip settings too. So could this be a Huawei oreo issue? Or coding within Xdrip?

comments.body: maybe some kind of optimization system app, that kills xDrip background process?

Xdrip has been set to ignore battery optimisation in the phone's app and battery settings. 
One part of the problem is likely related to bluetooth.. 
Second part, I tried the older wakelocks (battery and bluetooth) after someone suggested it could be the task scheduler used in the Android build that might be too aggressive.

Also, I have reset the transmitter to 0 days, tried the hacked dexcom app today, and have the same issues with the connectivity, while the screen is off. Seems the only workaround at the moment is to keep the screen on, even then it loses signal - hence one part of the problem is bluetooth, But I think xdrip was working better than the dexcom app.

some phones just don't work with xdrip. Try another brand.
Watch this https://m.facebook.com/groups/1021594524580709?view=permalink&id=1421286121278212

@lucychiu If the issue persists even with the Dexcom app, this cannot be an xDrip issue.
Would you please close this issue?
Or, would you please update?
Thanks
